text:
marie_finance: Heads up — Q1 committed invoice for BlueNova (INV-2025-0892) shows a burst/overage charge I wasn't expecting. Can someone reconcile what triggered this and whether SLA credit should apply?

ajay_billing: Pulling the invoice now. Quick snapshot of the lines: 
```
Dedicated Commit (reserved) - Feb 2025: $9,000
Burst overage - Feb 11: $1,120 (71,204 tokens routed to dedicated)
SLA credit: $0
```
Looks like no automatic SLA credit was applied. Tagging eng to confirm whether that usage was covered by customer commit or a misroute.

sam_engineering: digging into infra logs — I see fallback routing events around Feb 11 03:12:30–03:13:05 UTC. Region failover kicked routing policy to route traffic to Dedicated pool for a ~35s window. The requests used long-context generation which inflated token count. Request IDs: rq_9a2c, rq_9a3f, rq_9a8b. Likely misroute rather than genuine burst demand.

lisa_accounting: From accounting side we'll need an approved credit note and a journal entry description. If eng confirms misroute, what's the dollar amount to credit? Also want the incident/ticket so we can attach documentation for audit.

ajay_billing: Based on invoice line, proposed manual credit = $1,120. I'll open a billing adjustment if we have engineering confirmation and finance approval. Recommend creating a reason code: DED-BURST-MISROUTE to track similar cases.

sam_engineering: Confirmed misroute root cause: a cached routing tag wasn't invalidated during the region sync, so a small percentage of traffic erroneously failed over to Dedicated instead of Hosted. We've patched the tag invalidation and added a short-term guard to prevent multi-region fallback hitting dedicated pools for <2min windows.

sam_engineering: Suggested mitigation for billing: cap automatic burst billing to 20% of committed capacity per billing period; above that, require manual review/approval. This would avoid surprise micro-failovers charging large overages.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BIL-4451 — "Manual credit for INV-2025-0892 (DED-BURST-MISROUTE)". Audit trail started. Please confirm approval: /approve @marie_finance

marie_finance: Approved. Credit the full $1,120 and include the incident link and commit period in the adjustment note. Also approve the change request to add DED-BURST-MISROUTE as a reason code and to trial the 20% automatic-burst cap as a Q2 pricing experiment. Please record this as Finance-approved. :white_check_mark:

ajay_billing: Thanks — I'll push the adjustment and include BIL-4451 and the infra incident ID in the memo. Will notify BlueNova and reflect on next month's statement.

lisa_accounting: Noted — I'll prepare the journal entry and keep backup docs in the invoice folder.

sam_engineering: Added a short postmortem draft to infra-ops and linked BIL-4451. Closing the loop here, ping if audit needs more detail. :thumbsup:

marie_finance: Great, thanks everyone. Let's also add a short note to the Dedicated billing FAQ about burst caps and manual adjustments so CS doesn't get blindsided.
